<br>
主力净流入<br>
```<br>
LR=(ZDMRJE+BDMRJE)/10000;<br>
LC=(ZDMCJE+BDMCJE)/10000;<br>
JLR=LR-LC,万;<br>
STICKLINE(JLR&gt;0,0,JLR,7,0),color0000ff;<br>
STICKLINE(JLR&lt;0,0,JLR,7,0),color00ff00;<br>
净流入:JLR,colorred;<br>
D3:=EMA(JLR,3),colorgreen;<br>
D5:=EMA(JLR,5),colorcyan;<br>
D10:=EMA(JLR,10),coloryellow;<br>
```<br>
超级机构资金<br>
```<br>
超级机构:=超级机构明盘+超级机构暗盘;<br>
总成交额:=MONEY/10000;<br>
超级机构与成交占比:=IF(总成交额&gt;0,超级机构/总成交额*100,0);<br>
STICKLINE(超级机构&gt;0,0,超级机构,6,0),COLORRED;<br>
STICKLINE(超级机构&lt;0,0,超级机构,6,0),colorgreen;<br>
零线:0,colorgray;<br>
超级机构万:超级机构/10000,NODRAW,coloryellow;<br>
超级占比:超级机构与成交占比,NODRAW,coloryellow;<br>
明盘资金:超级机构明盘,NODRAW,coloryellow;<br>
暗盘资金:超级机构暗盘,NODRAW,coloryellow;<br>
```<br>
